info.title: NeuroMesh Node API
info.summary: Decentralized cognitive memory for autonomous agents.
info.description:
Every path below is served by a single NeuroMesh node. Paths are canonical at /api/v1; each operation also lists the unversioned aliases the bundled dashboard uses.

Error responses always have the shape `{error:{code,message,details},requestId}`. Branch on `error.code`, never on the message text.

Write operations return `202` with a job document and a `Location` header; poll `GET /api/v1/jobs/{id}` for per-step progress.

BadRequest.description: 400 - The request failed validation. `error.details` lists every problem at once.

Unauthorized.description: 401 - No API key, or an invalid one. Send X-API-Key or Authorization: Bearer.

Forbidden.description: 403 - Authenticated, but not permitted to perform this action on this object.

NotFound.description: 404 - No such route, or no such object.

Conflict.description: 409 - The action contradicts current state (already registered, nonce conflict).

PayloadTooLarge.description: 413 - The request body exceeded the configured limit.

BadGateway.description: 502 - An upstream (pinning service or RPC endpoint) failed.

ServiceUnavailable.description: 503 - A dependency is not ready, or this node is read-only. Retriable.

GatewayTimeout.description: 504 - An upstream did not answer within its budget.

get.description:
Always 200 while the process is up, including while draining. Touches no dependency: a liveness probe that fails because a third-party RPC endpoint is slow restarts a healthy pod. The Dockerfile HEALTHCHECK targets this path.

Also served at: /api/v1/health, /api/health.

200.description: Liveness probe.

get.description:
200 when every critical dependency is up, 503 otherwise and immediately once a drain begins. The body is identical at both statuses so a probe and the dashboard read the same document.

Also served at: /api/v1/ready, /api/ready.

200.description: Readiness probe.

get.description: Default process metrics plus the custom instruments. Guarded by METRICS_TOKEN when one is configured; 404 when metrics are disabled, so a disabled endpoint is indistinguishable from a nonexistent one.

200.description: Prometheus exposition.

Generated from the zod schemas and this route table, so it cannot drift.

Also served at: /api/docs.json, /api/v1/openapi.json.

200.description: The OpenAPI 3.1 document.

get.summary: A dependency-free HTML view of the OpenAPI document.
get.description: Rendered server-side from the same document. No CDN and no external script, because the CSP forbids both.

200.description: A dependency-free HTML view of the OpenAPI document.

get.summary: Node identity, chain, model, IPFS and protocol state.
get.description:
Assembled with Promise.allSettled, so one slow dependency degrades one field rather than failing the request. A field that cannot be determined is null with the reason in /readyz - never a placeholder string, and never a fabricated default. Cached 2 s.

Also served at: /api/status.

200.description: Node identity, chain, model, IPFS and protocol state.

post.summary: Register this node on the identity contract. Spends gas.
post.description:
Publishes the node's real compressed secp256k1 ENCRYPTION public key, which is derived separately from the wallet key. Preflights isRegistered so an already-registered agent is a 409 rather than a transaction that reverts. Returns 202 with a job.

Also served at: /api/agents/register, /api/v1/agent/register.

202.description: Register this node on the identity contract. Spends gas.

get.summary: One agent profile, with its reputation.
get.description:
The address is validated and checksummed before any chain read. A failed reputation read yields a null score rather than failing the identity lookup.

Also served at: /api/agents/:address, /api/v1/agent/:address.

200.description: One agent profile, with its reputation.

post.summary: Commit a memory. Spends gas and pays for a pin.
post.description:
Returns 202 with a job id; the six-step pipeline (embed, align, encrypt, pin, commit, confirm) runs in the background with a per-step duration. A failure after the pin runs a compensating unpin and the job still carries the CID, so a client is never left paying for storage it was not told about.

Also served at: /api/memories.

202.description: Commit a memory. Spends gas and pays for a pin.

get.summary: A page of the memories this node has committed.
get.description:
Served from an in-process index of what this node committed, which the response labels as source: local-index. The authoritative list is the ledger owner index and the MemoryCommitted log; a restart empties the cache and reconcile() refills it.

Also served at: /api/memories.

get.description:
The node fetches the bytes, checks sha2-256 against the CID, and parses them against the payload schema before answering, so the browser never talks to a third-party gateway and connect-src 'self' stays honest. Strong ETag; 304 on If-None-Match.

Also served at: /api/memories/:cid.

200.description: One memory, CID-verified server-side.

304.description: Not modified; the ETag still matches.

get.summary: The step-by-step verification report for one memory.
get.description:
Public by design: anyone should be able to check this node’s claims without holding a credential from it. A step the node cannot perform is reported as skip with a reason - skip is not pass.

Also served at: /api/memories/:cid/verify.

200.description: The step-by-step verification report for one memory.

post.summary: Unwrap one memory this node was granted access to.
post.description:
Takes NO ciphertext: the only input is the CID in the path, and the request body schema is an empty strict object. The node fetches the bytes, verifies them against the CID, and unwraps only a recipient entry addressed to its own agent address and key version. Authenticated, tightly rate limited, and audited on every call.

Also served at: /api/memories/:cid/decrypt.

requestBody.description: Deliberately empty and strict. This endpoint accepts NO caller-supplied ciphertext; the only input is the CID in the path.

200.description: Unwrap one memory this node was granted access to.

get.description:
Authenticated, because enumerating job ids would defeat the capability that makes GET /jobs/:id safe without a key.

Also served at: /api/jobs.

200.description: Recent jobs, for operator debugging.

get.summary: One job status, with per-step timings.
get.description:
No API key: the job id is a UUIDv4 capability that only its creator has seen. That trade obliges a client never to log the id to a shared sink or place it in a cross-origin URL.

Also served at: /api/jobs/:id.

200.description: One job status, with per-step timings.

post.description:
Runs one embedding inference, so it has its own rate-limit bucket and sheds load with 503 model_not_ready rather than queueing behind a model that is still loading. Every response carries diagnostics.noiseBaseline: any similarity near it is indistinguishable from a comparison between unrelated vectors.

Also served at: /api/semantic/search.

200.description: Trust-weighted semantic search.

get.description:
Computed from vectors already in the index; it runs no inference, so a GET can never trigger a model download. Pairs whose projection ids differ are skipped rather than scored, and every cell carries a significance flag against the noise baseline.

Also served at: /api/semantic/similarity.

get.summary: Scores and the recent trust log.
get.description:
Scores are read from the contract and converted from WAD in exactly one place; scoreWad travels alongside the float so a caller needing exactness is not forced through a Number. The trust log is a capacity-bounded ring buffer and the response says so.

Also served at: /api/reputation.

Preflighted in the reputation service: self-endorsement, an unregistered target, a duplicate endorsement and an unexpired cooldown are all refused before any gas is spent. Returns 202 with a job.

get.summary: Benchmark data from the last local simulation run.
get.description:
Answers 200 with available:false when the gitignored simulation-results.json is absent, because that is the default state of a fresh clone rather than a fault. The five chart arrays are always present, empty when there is no file, so no view branches on a missing key. Read asynchronously, mtime-cached, and capped at 8 MB.

Also served at: /api/simulation-results, /api/v1/simulation.

200.description: Benchmark data from the last local simulation run.

get.summary: Latency and counter summary for the dashboard.
get.description:
Percentiles are exact over the last 200 observations per stage, not interpolated from histogram buckets; the response reports sampleWindow so the scope of the estimate is visible.

Also served at: /api/metrics/summary.

200.description: Latency and counter summary for the dashboard.
